used.how: minimal_matmul was the rule's choice for bf16 wide-N projections; at M=160 with replicated weights it lost to 1D mcast (0.273 vs 0.199 ms wq_b), so mm_configs.rule takes 1D for Mt <= 8 ahead of the minimal entry
the batched wo_a (8 groups x 160 rows) stays on the 2D fuse_batch=False family at bw32 (0.207 ms); MatmulMultiCoreReuseProgramConfig not tried
the chip's 160 rows (mesh_partition of q_resid over TP) are WindowGeometry.query_offsets / the indexer's Sq block, so sparse_sdpa's index lists and the local top-k need no change
after three one-card tt-probe runs the 8x4 open failed (SAT placement, no PGD grouping); a --mesh probe (whole-box reset) restored it before the measure was re-run

missing: K-57's symptom list lacks this run's message: after a one-card probe the 8x4 open raised 'SAT placement: mesh M0 has no PGD grouping and no embeddable MGD fallback' (physical_grouping_descriptor_matching.cpp:3117)
all_to_all_async_generic's in_dim is the concatenated dim and out_dim the split one (added as DS41-138)

replicating attention weights makes the 160-row projections DRAM-bound, ~3x a call vs the column split; the SP=32 study's -20..-26 ms estimate left that out (measured -11 ms attention; added as DS41-139)
measure --part only knows the runs of the task's ab_mode: P.9 is quick, so 'measure --part test_ladder' printed 'no run matches' and only 'quick' exists

overseer.evidence: nothing padded or zero-filled: the replicated weights are the owner's option B (FLOPs a chip unchanged, 160 rows x full N instead of 640 x N/4). The kernel limit hit (all_to_all row padding 40 % 16) came from wrong dims, fixed by DS41-138, not worked around. The M=160 cost was tuned with a config (mm_configs 1D mcast), not by inflating work
